## Original article text

````markdown
Don't waste your time with nested AND, OR, NOT.
You can do it indirectly with <a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/compare">comparison</a>.

|||
| -------- | -------- |
| XOR | `A != B` |
| XNOR | `A == B` |
````
